head.shape: large simple rounded head, smooth circular/oval silhouette
head.detail_level: minimal facial geometry, no realistic skin texture, no detailed human facial anatomy

eyes.style: two small solid black dot eyes
eyes.detail_level: no realistic pupils, no detailed irises, no photorealistic eyes

nose.constraint: at most extremely subtle implied geometry; never realistic

hair.style: dark, messy, spiky, slightly irregular spikes
hair.constraint: must not change style, color, length, or texture between scenes

body.build: slim/average, youthful, not muscular, not extremely skinny
body.constraint: not chibi, not realistic human anatomy
body.hands: simplified but must convincingly interact with objects

navy_hoodie.description: navy blue pullover hoodie with white hoodie drawstrings, black/dark sweatpants, simple white sneakers

navy_sweater.note: use only if scene metadata explicitly requests it; pending confirmation against reference images

references.note: populate in Phase 3/4 dataset import step
